document: per-finding disposition of the Codex review of rqls_fixedb_lm_v6 + fixedb_q1_check_v4 in rqls_fixedb_lm_v7 + fixedb_q1_check_v5 (written only; nothing executed)
author: ContinueRQLS10b

supervisor_api_bound.note: bound by digest and receipt schema through the manifest; v7 itself is under separate parent review

controls_unchanged: stages, seeds, amplitudes, thresholds, slots, gates and stop rules are those of v6; S anchors additionally pass through the common endpoint assessment (finding 7) without changing the S_anchors pass rule

findings.title: checker lacks frozen source/runtime/input binding
findings.v7: checker v5 takes a parent-frozen MANIFEST (checker, assay, supervisor, config, interpreter, NumPy version/file/extension digests, input digests, budget, counts) and requires: own sha256; config sha256; exact assay argv; one output root with fixed direct-child names; supervisor and assay sha256 in launch record, receipt and assay header; identity tuple (positive pid = pgid, uniqueid, idversion, uid) equal across launch record, receipt and header (header pgid and ppid checked); runtime and input digests from the S gates; artifact digests equal to the checker's own reads; output-root inventory equal to the expected names (receipt inventory and directory listing); clock ordering and plan arithmetic

findings.title: safety and settlement checks fail open
findings.v7: explicit typed fields required: SETTLED in receipt and settlement record, empty failure latch, loop EXITED, trips only DEADLINE, stop reason and identity-checked signal, GO delivered and stdin closed, final census blocking_live == [] and other_uid_blocking == [], both streams closed/error-free/not overflowed, every helper OK and none open, deadline timeliness; every sample strictly parsed with a census and within lane_busy, lane_rss, free and output limits, no failures, increasing monotonic time, count equal to samples_written; absence confirmed only by FileNotFoundError, any other inspection error fails

findings.title: mandatory controls trusted from booleans
findings.v7: each mandatory gate exactly once and passed, all before the earliest W/WD/WS record or stage, and each equal to the checker's reconstruction: S thresholds re-checked from details, three S anchor endpoint records, N/C/KR run records, KP exactly seeds seed0+{0..3} at amp 1e-3 and seed0+{10..13} at amp 1e-2 per anchor, one record each, verified, md < 1e-8, rays 49/64 where prescribed, no skip records for them, distinct seeds; no defect or candidate anywhere; the W skip count uses NW from the manifest

findings.title: WD predicate and latency fields do not prove the behaviour
findings.v7: assay records first_work_mono (after the first normal-equation assembly) and halt_first/halt_final; checker requires first_work_mono < supervisor mono_sent <= term_mono <= halt_final.mono <= mono_lm_end, halt in the LM (not entry/initial residual), it >= 1, else UNEXERCISED_WD; W completion bounded by the STAGE_END record written after the summary write (<= 2 s after the plan end), effective deadline arithmetic validated; latency: receipt mono_end (taken after reaping, census and stream closure) within 7 s of mono_sent and of the trip, plus the settlement record birth time (after receipt persistence, wall clock) within 7 s of the stop request epoch
findings.residual: supervisor v7 records no monotonic receipt-persistence timestamp; the persistence bound uses the settlement record's filesystem birth time (wall clock)

findings.title: startup and initialization outside the guarded boundary
findings.v7: protected post-GO bootstrap: argument validation, output preflight, exclusive OUT creation, TERM reconcile, NumPy import inside the protected path (BOOTSTRAP_FAIL with stop receipt), TERM reconcile; RNG construction inside guarded initialisation; guarded Problem construction; S checks between every numerical bundle; logical start boundaries stated without atomicity claims

findings.title: final halt telemetry and close ordering
findings.v7: halt_first and halt_final kept separately (later TERMINATED supersedes DEADLINE; status == halt_final.reason); JSONL fsynced and closed before the explicit TERM boundary and the exit decision; candidate 7 / defect 8 keep priority; the stop receipt carries the final record and byte counts and any close error

findings.title: persistence incomplete; S stop policy
findings.v7: complete-write loops rejecting zero progress for JSONL, witness and stop receipt; JSONL write errors are persistence failures (exit 9); all destinations preflighted; persistence contract stated (exclusive create + complete write + fsync before close; JSONL fsynced at close; no crash-durability claim for unfsynced records); S anchor endpoints go through assess_endpoint (witness first, record, exit 7/8)

findings.title: strict JSON and schemas incomplete
findings.v7: checker rejects duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity constants and overflowing literals (parse_float), validates schemas inside guarded blocks (missing keys or types give FAIL_* verdicts, not crashes), requires three finite nonnegative Gram deviations with md == max(mdf), validates witness/record/stop receipt before classifying exit 7 or 8, and maps other exits to FAIL_CHILD_EXIT (never UNEXERCISED); assay emits only finite numbers (null plus reason flags otherwise), allow_nan=False everywhere

findings.title: single-thread gate empirical only
findings.v7: NumPy 2.4.3 here links Apple Accelerate for BLAS and LAPACK (otool; numpy __config__); the assay establishes single-threaded Accelerate with BLASSetThreading(BLAS_THREADING_SINGLE_THREADED) on the main thread before any numerical work and re-queries BLASGetThreading() == 1 after identification (vecLib thread_api.h, macOS 15+); identifies loaded dyld images, NumPy extension digests and interpreter digest; S_runtime fails if any of this cannot be established; the CPU/wall ratio stays as supporting telemetry (unchanged gate); input files hashed and parsed from the same bytes
findings.residual: the Accelerate setting is per thread; all numerics run on the main thread (recorded); the API result is a library-reported configuration, not an observation of every internal kernel

findings.title: naming and checker integration
findings.v7: minsep_nonclose_pair replaces minsep_nonmerged with its definition; checker v5 names itself correctly and exits 0 only for PASS (1 other verdicts, 2 checker error)

q1_layout_required_by_checker_v5.outputs: assay.jsonl required, witness.json and stop-receipt.json not required
q1_layout_required_by_checker_v5.manifest: fixedb_q1_manifest_v1 frozen by the parent before the run; the checker OUT path must lie outside the output root

not_done: no execution; no Q1 config or manifest written (needs the supervisor review outcome and a GO); W8 E1-E4 untouched
